title: Behind Mizaj: from Ibn Sina to modern psychology
caption:
The idea behind Mizaj is over a thousand years old.

Hippocrates and Galen described four humours. Ibn Sina organised them in his Canon of Medicine around 1025, and the book was studied for centuries. Through Unani tradition, those four temperaments reached South Asia, our hakeems and our grandparents' advice. We joined that heritage with modern type psychology, in our own language.

Did anyone in your family ever visit a hakeem? Tell us the story.
